newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair sells Uto to Oerlikon.
newsitem.headline: Swissair sells Uto to Oerlikon.

text.p: Swissair AG said it planned to sell its real estate trading and adminstration activities to Oerlikon-Buerhle Immobilien AG, a unit of Oerlikon-Buehrle, for an undisclosed amount.
Swissair's real estate activities are grouped in unit Uto Holding Beteiligungen AG.
Swissair said in a statement that the disposal was part of its ongoing efforts to focus on core business.
The units to be sold to Oerlikon are Uto Management AG of Zurich, Uto AG of Zurich, Regie Schmid SA of Geneva and Horizon Immobilien AG of Zurich.
The 80 staff affected will be employed by the new Uto Albis AG, which will have a workforce of some 150 people.
In a separate statement, Oerlikon said Uto Albis will be Switzerland's second largest property management company, administrating more than 60,000 rental contracts.
